item.title: Frozen shrimp sold in multiple states recalled due to possible radioactive contamination, FDA says
item.description: Direct Source Seafood LLC is recalling 83,800 bags of frozen raw shrimp because the product may be contaminated with cesium-137, a human-induced radioisotope of cesium, according to the Food and Drug Administration. To date, no illnesses related to the shrimp recall have been reported.The shrimp, imported from Indonesia, were sold under the Market 32 and Waterfront Bistro brands. item.title: Major crash on Pennsylvania Turnpike halts traffic near Bensalem
item.description: A serious crash on the Pennsylvania Turnpike is causing significant traffic delays. Traffic delays on the Pennsylvania Turnpike The crash involved a dump truck, several cars, and at least one van. It is affecting traffic between exits 343 for Willow Grove and 351 for Bensalem. Authorities are on the scene, and SKYFOX provided live coverage over I-276 East. The exact cause of the crash and the condition of those involved have not been confirmed yet.

item.title: Officer hurt after crash in Trenton: police
item.description: A Trenton police vehicle responding to a call was involved in a crash this afternoon. The crash occurred near West Ingham Avenue and Calhoun Street just before 4:00 p.m. The officer driving the police vehicle was taken to the hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. Police confirmed that the people in the other car were not injured. A third vehicle involved in the incident sustained only minor damage.
